actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.enrich_company.description: Retrieve comprehensive information about a company.
actions.enrich_company.props.companyIden: Company slug, LinkedIn URL, or encoded ID
actions.enrich_profile.description: Retrieve detailed professional data, work/personal email and phone for a person.
actions.enrich_profile.props.profileIden: LinkedIn URL, public ID, or encoded ID
actions.reasoning_search.description: Describe who you are looking for in plain language. An AI agent builds the best filters and runs the search. It may return status "needs_input" with questions — answer by calling again with the returned session_id and an answers object.
actions.reasoning_search.props.answers.d: Answers to a needs_input turn, e.g. {"company_size":"201-500"}. Requires Session ID.
Whether to search people or companies
actions.reasoning_search.props.enrichLiv: Enrich results with fresh live data instead of cached data
actions.reasoning_search.props.maxResult: Number of results for the final search (1-100)
actions.reasoning_search.props.query.des: Plain-language description, e.g. "Heads of Sales at French fintech scale-ups" (max 3000 chars). Required on the first call.
actions.reasoning_search.props.sessionId: Session id returned by a previous call. Send it back to answer questions or refine the same search.
actions.search_companies.description: Find companies with advanced filters (industry, LinkedIn URL, size, location, growth, funding, investor...).
actions.search_companies.props.advancedF: Optional raw filter group, e.g. {"op":"or","conditions":[{"column":"skill","type":"like","value":"python"}]}. Merged with the filters above.
actions.search_companies.props.enrichLiv: Enrich results with fresh live data
actions.search_companies.props.filters.d: Conditions used to filter the search
actions.search_companies.props.offset.de: Pagination offset - number of results to skip
actions.search_people.description: Find professionals using 50+ filters (title, company, LinkedIn URL, skills, location, education, funding...).
actions.search_people.props.advancedFilt: Optional raw filter group, e.g. {"op":"or","conditions":[{"column":"skill","type":"like","value":"python"}]}. Merged with the filters above.
actions.search_people.props.enrichLive.d: Enrich results with fresh live data
actions.search_people.props.filters.desc: Conditions used to filter the search
actions.search_people.props.offset.descr: Pagination offset - number of results to skip
actions.typeahead.description: Resolve the exact stored value for a search filter (company, industry, category, location, school, title, skill, investor). Use it before filtering, or when a search returns few/no results.
actions.typeahead.props.q.description: Partial text to autocomplete (1-100 characters), e.g. "pyth"
auth.description: Your DataForB2B API key. Get it from https://app.dataforb2b.ai
description: Power your sales or recruiting AI agent with live B2B data. DataForB2B is a people and company search API with 70+ filters including job title, skills, company size, LinkedIn URL, funding stage, investor, past employers, certifications, years of experience, GitHub repositories, languages and more.
